head.t: Fisher and Paykel locked in as sole supplier for respiratory consumables at St George's
head.x: St George's University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust has made a direct, sole-source award to Fisher and Paykel Healthcare worth £750,000 for invasive, non-invasive and nasal high-flow consumables, citing their compatibility with equipment the trust already has in place.

head.t: 14 urgent care schemes to receive share of £140m to help tackle winter pressures
head.x: £140 million in funding will be invested in 14 new urgent care schemes across England to help tackle winter pressures, the government has announced, aiming to increase capacity and improve patient flow. These schemes include ED improvements, new urgent treatment centres, and enhancements to digital systems.

f.t: Impact of side hole design of drainage cannulas on flow in veno-venous ECMO circuits – Full Text
f.x: "When reducing the blood-flow rate in ECMO therapy, stagnation areas may develop within the drainage cannula. The geometry of the side holes has an important impact. A comparison of the different designs shows that distal growth of the side hole area results in improved flow behaviour" Bongert et al (2026).

f.t: Non-invasive FFR tool gains US FDA clearance
f.x: Elucid has announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 510(k) clearance of FFR-IQ, its software for non-invasive estimation of fractional flow reserve (FFR) from coronary CT angiography (FFR-CT).
